cohort: Extremely low gestational age neonates (ELGANs, <27 weeks' gestation) with symptomatic patent ductus arteriosus (sPDA) admitted to a tertiary neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) in Vietnam, including a historical cohort treated with ibuprofen or intravenous paracetamol after sPDA diagnosis (n = 104) and a prophylactic paracetamol cohort (n = 76).
finding: Prophylactic paracetamol in ELGANs in an LMIC setting did not reduce the need for surgical ligation for PDA, sPDA rates, or other PDA-related morbidities in infants surviving beyond 7 days of age.
